globalStats.description: Established Globally by Mrs. Eunice Kennedy Shriver

purpose.vision: Special Olympics envisions a world where people with intellectual disabilities lead healthy, vibrant lives grounded in ongoing sports and physical activities, sound nutrition and a deeply held commitment to improve, compete, achieve and demonstrate their personal bests to themselves and their communities.
purpose.mission: To promote and provide year-round sports training and athletic competition in a variety of Olympic-type sports for children and adults with intellectual disabilities, giving them continuing opportunities to develop physical fitness, demonstrate courage, experience joy, and participate in a sharing of gifts, skills, and friendship with their families, other Special Olympics athletes, and the community.

timeline.title: Founding
timeline.text: Established in Singapore as an adjunct committee of MINDS and APSN.

timeline.title: VWO Registration
timeline.text: Officially registered as an independent voluntary welfare organisation with the Registrar of Societies.

timeline.title: Charity Status
timeline.text: Officially registered as a charity with the Commissioner of Charities (IPC status valid through 15 Sept 2027).

objectives.text: Organise continuous sports training programmes and competitions for children and adults with intellectual disabilities.
Provide opportunities for athletes to represent and participate in National, Regional, and World Special Olympics Games.
Promote social integration between Special Olympics athletes and mainstream athletes through unified team sports.
Encourage family involvement, strengthen community ties, and increase public awareness and respect for individuals with intellectual disabilities.
